description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for parsing various WDMP request types, forming responses, and mapping status codes to messages in a network management context. It includes functions for parsing get/set requests, responses for get/set operations, attribute responses, table and row management, and internal status mappings.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to extract get request parameters, including OID or names and optional attributes.

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to extract set request parameters, including parameter names, values, and data types.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to extract attribute setting requests, focusing on notification attributes.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a test-and-set request JSON, including old and new CIDs, synchronization info, and parameters.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a replace rows request with multiple row entries, each with parameter names and values.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to add a single row to a table, including parameter names and values.

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a request to delete a specific row by name.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for a get request, including parameters, values, statuses, and message mapping.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_get_attr_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Creates a JSON response for attribute get requests, including notification attributes and status.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Forms a JSON response for set request outcomes, including status messages.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_table_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Creates a response JSON for table row operations, such as adding or replacing rows, with status.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_test_and_set_response(res_struct * resObj,cJSON * response)
methods.description: Generates a response JSON for test-and-set request status and parameters.

methods.name: void mapWdmpStatusToStatusMessage(WDMP_STATUS status,char * result)
methods.description: Maps WDMP status codes to human-readable status message strings.

methods.name: void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE * statusCode,int paramCount,WDMP_STATUS * ret)
methods.description: Determines the overall response status code based on individual parameter statuses.

ctags.name: getStatusCode
ctags.pattern: /^ void getStatusCode(WDMP_RESPONSE_STATUS_CODE *statusCode, int paramCount, WDMP_STATUS * ret)$/
